serverInfo.description: Eveoy brings real customers into real stores — you pay $24.99 only after a real person shows up, spends 10+ minutes, buys, and brings back photos and a video. No-shows are refunded. This is your Eveoy expert associate inside any AI: ask how it works, what it costs, or which industries it serves. Here to help and educate, not sell — it can place an order when you're ready. Start with the eveoy://kb/for-agents resource.

auth.description: All tools are anonymous. Write tools (subscribe_newsletter, capture_profile, start_checkout, request_human, book_demo) accept contact details as arguments but require no OAuth sign-in. The protected-resource metadata endpoint is advertised for spec compliance only.
